planning_notes: Mapping from A0 (analog value) to blink period within 0.2~2.0 s is handled in the SysML model; this proposal only provides the required electrical ports for D13 and A0.
A0 is configured as analog_input with catalog default behavior (no explicit scale/offset provided).
D13 LED output is modeled as a boolean digital output; active_high defaults to catalog default (assumed true unless the circuit facts later specify otherwise).
No serial requirements were provided; serial_channels is left empty.
No additional wiring beyond the explicit D13 role and A0 control role was specified.
